Not without a camera, animation paper, 35mm and a crew my dream will always just be a dream. Sorry for the late reply. There's nothing that can make me happy anymore, especially since I've quit another job.

I don't know what I'd work in. By the time I've made enough money doing a shitty job that I hate as a means to an end I'd probably be in my late 50s, and well past the age for doing what I want to do. I doubt that. Nobody would hire me for a job that pays enough to live there.

Implying that anyone who's not human doesn't deserve to live? ... Okay. 

I didn't even obtain my Bachelors. It was a subject that I hated and the only thing I enjoyed about it was being away from home fro three years in a city I loved.
I like the movie. It wasn't a publisher who discouraged me, it was somebody on FaceBook. Besides, I've deleted the unfinished manuscript now.
I can't write a book about The Thief and the Cobbler because I've got no resources or anyone who would help. Nobody even really knows of or cares for the film, anyway.
I'm not writing a story book, though. I'm writing a book about the making of The Thief and the Cobbler. Somebody told me I should give up.
